note: Copy to templates/x/bank.json and make these yours. That file is git-ignored.

templates.name: One number
templates.when: A single real metric is the whole post.

slots.the_number_in_context: The number and what it is measuring, in one line.
slots.what_it_means: One line of interpretation. No call to action.

templates.name: The correction
templates.when: You were wrong about something in public and now know better.

slots.what_you_said_before: The claim, stated without softening it.

templates.name: Build note
templates.when: A small concrete thing you shipped or fixed today.

slots.the_detail_that_makes_it_interesting: The non-obvious part. If there isn't one, do not post.

templates.name: Breakdown thread
templates.when: Something needs sequence to make sense. Numbered 1/, 2/, and split per tweet.

slots.the_claim: The whole thread in one line. If this line is not worth reading, nothing below it will be read.
slots.what_you_would_do_differently: The actual change, or an honest admission that you would do it again.

templates.name: A question you actually want answered
templates.when: You genuinely do not know, and the answer would change what you build. Never as engagement bait.

slots.the_context_that_makes_it_a_real_questio: What you already tried. This is what separates it from bait.
slots.the_question: One question. Specific enough to answer in a sentence.
